mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS decreases and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with a decrease in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals a tightening monetary policy with controlled inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases and CPIAUCSL decreases and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.
